question.text: The terms of co-investment in an investee company by investors shall:

answer.text: Be more favourable than the AIF's investment terms
Not be more favourable than the AIF's investment terms
Be entirely at the discretion of the co-investor

explanation.text: The Logic: Co-investment terms in an investee company must not be more favourable than the Category I/II AIF's investment terms, and the timing of exit must be identical to the AIF scheme's exit from that investment. The Trap: Options suggesting more favourable terms, discretion, or no restrictions misstate the regulation; the parity-with-the-AIF rule is explicit. Note: Source page 67 of Series XIX-A AIF (Category I and II) Distributors workbook.
